pairs.registryProposal: The conformant floor (half of 25 techniques, 13 distinct anchors) is effectively unreachable for a narrow context such as one command module or one repo layer, because most test-harness techniques (history-driven-partitioning, flake-lifecycle, long-lane-certification, context-starved-executor, far-side-oracle) are properties of the harness, not of a context. Consider a per-technique scope field (harness-wide vs per-suite) so a context is judged only against the techniques that can be realized inside it.
